title: Reconciliar chunks STT legacy atascados en transcribing
mission: Reconcile the five legacy study_transcript_chunks still marked transcribing since 2026-09-11 using metadata/aggregate-only evidence first. Determine whether they are stale/orphaned versus legitimately active, and materialize only a safe reversible repair if the state machine and ownership evidence make that unambiguous. Never read or persist transcript/provisional_text content, room/session secrets, or credentials.
definition_of_done: Fresh aggregate-only evidence confirms the count/timestamps of nonterminal legacy rows without reading transcript text.
Each lingering state is classified as active, stale/orphaned, or SOURCE_DEBT using durable processing timestamps and the current STT state machine.
Any repair is reversible and bounded; if ownership semantics are insufficient, no row status is mutated and exact SOURCE_DEBT is returned.
No transcript, provisional text, participant private content, room token, credential, Current/Human Accepted/Served, or production authority boundary is exposed or changed.
